description: HubSpot quick actions: lookups, stats and single changes — "show me [company]", "open deals", "pipeline value", "create a task", "update [deal]", "move [deal] to [stage]", "create a deal for [company]", "how many contacts", "/hubspot", "hey HubSpot" — and any CRM question without a more specific skill in scope. Not for the revenue loop: ICP, dedupe and lead lists go to hubspot-crm, scoring new leads to hubspot-lead-triage, "did anyone reply", "update the CRM" or "sync lemlist to HubSpot" to close-the-loop, and "run the engine" or one-sentence campaign requests to revenue-engine.
